run_path_planning_using_a_star: run A-star path planning on an occupancy grid from a robot start pose to a goal XY position
convert_convert_cg_pcd_to_pkl: convert a CG point cloud PCD file to a downsampled pickle file for occupancy grid use
get_get_occupancy_grid: get or build an occupancy grid from a cached pickle or point cloud source file
compute_angle_between_vectors: compute the angle in radians and degrees between two numpy vectors using dot product
convert_path_to_real_waypoints: convert a raw A-star grid path into filtered real-world waypoints with yaw angles
